name: JKTDC Yusmarg Resort Dining Hall
signature_dish: rice with dal and chicken curry
why_it_matters: The only proper restaurant on the meadow — a JKTDC-run dining hall inside the Yusmarg Resort complex (Tourist Bungalow + cottages). Day-trippers buy a small entry ticket to the JKTDC ground; overnighters eat here by default because nothing else stays open after sunset.
insider_tip: Order ahead — the kitchen cooks to order, not buffet, so a 6 pm dinner request placed at check-in arrives without the hour-long wait walk-ins face. Carry snacks anyway; the menu is fixed (parathas + omelette / dal-chawal-chicken) and runs out on weekends.
signature_address: JKTDC Yusmarg Resort, Yusmarg, Budgam 191111, Jammu & Kashmir

name: Tribe Homestay & Cafe
why_it_matters: A small homestay-cafe on the main road through Nagbal village — the lay-by you pass right before the Yusmarg meadow. Run by host Uzair; food is cooked by the family, not a commercial kitchen. The only non-JKTDC sit-down option in the immediate Yusmarg cluster.
insider_tip: It is a homestay first — phone or WhatsApp ahead (+91 7006510747) before you arrive; walk-ins for lunch can be turned away if no rooms are occupied that day. Sit on the wooden veranda for the Doodhganga valley view.
signature_address: Main Road, Nagbal, Yusmarg, Budgam 191113, Jammu & Kashmir
